Championship:

Various forms of competition can be referred to by the term championship. In our case, the Championship means First stage league, the second stage knockout.

Tournament:

A tournament is a competition type in which four or more teams, or many participants, compete in the same sport or game. A single-elimination, knockout, or sudden death tournament is a type of elimination tournament where the loser of each match-up is immediately eliminated from the tournament.

Pyramid:

Pyramid Competition System enables players to challenge each other to a match, the winners move up and the losers move down. The aim is to get to the top of the Pyramid. Players are listed in a shape of a pyramid and ranked top to bottom, left to right. The ranking varies based on match results (new players start at the bottom of the Pyramid). Players can challenge others (i) to the left of them on the same row, or (ii) one row above.

League:

In a league, individual players or groups of teams in a particular sport compete with each other. Every participant of the league plays at least one game with all the others. Points are collected according to the results. After all games are played, those who collect the most points win.
